name: Ragna
source:
Scion El is a town that enjoys peace after sealing an evil spirit. But as a young prince inherits the kingdom, disarray starts to spread out. Neighboring country enemy forces overrun Scion El. The young king returns to his deprived town and decides to fight against the invaders.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
斯昂·埃尔在封印邪灵后享受着和平。然而，年轻王子继承王位后，混乱开始蔓延。邻国敌军攻占斯昂·埃尔。年轻国王回到被夺走的城镇，决定对抗入侵者。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
